final_candidates.decision_summary: Fully conserved Phe60 replaced by Pro is evolutionarily intolerable, scored implausible by ESM-1v, and only modestly structurally compatible on the 1PSE backbone. Buried aromatic-to-Pro substitution in the C-terminal core is strongly folding-disruptive.

Trp17 is fully conserved with zero evolutionary tolerance for substitution; replacing a conserved buried aromatic with proline in the N-terminal hydrophobic core is strongly destabilizing. Lacks PLM/structure evidence, capping confidence slightly below F60P.

Gly31→Pro is evolutionarily intolerable, implausible to the PLM, and the most structurally incompatible candidate on the 1PSE backbone. Gly→Pro can occasionally be tolerated in turns, so it ranks third among the disruptive Pro substitutions.

stop_reason.detail: Final round reached and the top three disruptive Pro substitutions are stable and well-supported by converging MSA, PLM, and structure evidence.

history.rationale: Phe-to-Pro in the C-terminal region disrupts helix and removes aromatic packing simultaneously.

Proline replacing a buried conserved aromatic is structurally intolerable (zero MSA frequency, ESM-1v ~0, MPNN ΔlogP=-3.31), consistent with helix/core disruption. Slightly less extreme than G31P on the PLM/MPNN dimensions.
Zero evolutionary tolerance and lowest PLM plausibility with mild structural penalty; core aromatic-to-Pro remains the strongest disruption hypothesis.
Conserved buried aromatic replaced by proline; evolution and PLM scores near zero indicate low natural tolerance, consistent with core disruption.

F60 is fully conserved (E00001), ESM-1v scores the substitution as implausible (E00004), and ProteinMPNN shows only modest structural compatibility (E00007), all consistent with a folding-disruptive knockout mutation.

A second conserved aromatic-to-Pro substitution (Trp17 in the N-terminal hydrophobic core) follows the same logic that made F60P disruptive: burying a proline where a large aromatic packs. Needs tool evidence next round.
W17 is conserved (entropy 1.485) with zero Pro among homologs, supporting disruptive potential; still needs PLM and structure evidence to compare with F60P.
Trp17 is highly conserved per MSA (z=0.000) and a Pro substitution in the N-terminal hydrophobic core should destabilize folding; still needs structure/PLM evidence next round.

E00010 shows zero evolutionary tolerance for Trp17 substitution (mutant-residue frequency ~0), confirming W17 is conserved; a conserved buried aromatic replaced by proline is strongly destabilizing. Confidence nudged up slightly but capped pending PLM/structure evidence.
